name: Insulin glargine / lixisenatide
className: Fixed combination of basal insulin and GLP-1 receptor agonist

availability.note: No UK SmPC or PIL found for insulin glargine + lixisenatide (or lixisenatide alone): emc search by trade name (both spellings) and by ingredient returned no results; the MHRA Products index has no document with lixisenatide as an active substance (searched 2026-10-17). MHRA Drug Safety Update (29 January 2026, GLP-1 receptor agonists and acute pancreatitis) states that lixisenatide is no longer authorised in the UK: https://www.gov.uk/drug-safety-update/glp-1-receptor-agonists-and-dual-glp-1-slash-gip-receptor-agonists-strengthened-warnings-on-acute-pancreatitis-including-necrotising-and-fatal-cases . Not filled from withdrawn or non-UK labels.
